# stellaris-build.com

> A community platform for sharing, discovering, and optimizing Stellaris empire builds. Covers all game elements: species traits, origins, ethics, authorities, civics, ascension perks, and tradition trees. Supports Stellaris versions 4.2 "Corvus" and 4.3 "Cetus".

## About

Stellaris Build is a free, open community website where players of Stellaris (the 4X grand strategy game by Paradox Interactive) can create and share complete empire build configurations. Each build captures the full empire setup: species class, traits, origin, ethics, authority, civics, ruler traits, ascension perk order, and tradition tree order.

The site is updated with each major Stellaris patch and includes data extracted directly from the game files, ensuring accuracy and completeness.

## What is a Stellaris Build?

A "build" in Stellaris is a complete empire configuration optimized for a particular playstyle (e.g., military conquest, economic tall, research rush, roleplay). It includes:
- Species class and traits (biological, lithoid, machine, robot)
- Origin (how the empire started)
- Ethics (the empire's values: materialist, militarist, etc.)
- Government authority (democratic, oligarchic, imperial, corporate, etc.)
- Civics (government policies and institutions)
- Starting ruler traits
- Recommended ascension perks (in priority order)
- Recommended tradition trees (in unlock order)

## Supported Game Versions

- Stellaris 4.3 "Cetus" (latest)
- Stellaris 4.2 "Corvus"

## Features

- Browse and search community builds with filters by version, ethics, authority, and civics
- Create builds with full game data validation (trait points, civic compatibility, ethics limits, etc.)
- Authentication via Google or Steam OAuth
- Curated community resources: guides, YouTube channels, tools, mods, and communities
- All game data is version-aware and sourced directly from Stellaris game files

## Key Pages

- https://stellaris-build.com/ — Browse all community builds
- https://stellaris-build.com/create — Create a new build (requires login)
- https://stellaris-build.com/resources — Curated Stellaris community resources

## Data Coverage (Stellaris 4.3)

- 349 species traits
- 55 playable origins
- 17 ethics
- 7 authorities
- 207 playable civics
- 44 ascension perks
- 32 tradition trees
- 18 species classes
